Module de.learnlib.testsupport.it
Package de.learnlib.testsupport.it.util

Class LockableOracle<I,D>

java.lang.Object
de.learnlib.testsupport.it.util.LockableOracle<I,D>
Type Parameters:
I - input symbol type
D - output domain
All Implemented Interfaces:
BatchProcessor<Query<I,D>>, MembershipOracle<I,D>, QueryAnswerer<I,D>
Direct Known Subclasses:
DFALockableOracle, MealyLockableOracle, MMLTLockableOracle, MooreLockableOracle, SBALockableOracle, SEVPALockableOracle, SPALockableOracle, SPMMLockableOracle
public class LockableOracle<I,D> extends Object implements MembershipOracle<I,D>
A lockable oracle is a MembershipOracle whose actions can be blocked by setting its lock. During testing, this can be helpful for detecting whether learning algorithms are posing queries beyond hypothesis construction (which they really should not).

    • processQuery

      public void processQuery(Query<I,D> query)
      Description copied from interface: MembershipOracle
      Processes a single query. When this method returns, the Query.answer(Object) method of the supplied object will have been called with an argument reflecting the SUL response to the respective query.

      The default implementation of this method will simply wrap the provided Query in a singleton Collection using Collections.singleton(Object). Implementations in subclasses should override this method to circumvent the Collection object creation, if possible.

      Specified by:
      processQuery in interface MembershipOracle<I,D>
      Parameters:
      query - the query to process
